    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT ensembl_gene_id_2 AS a, ensembl_gene_id_1 AS b
    FROM interaction_consensus
    WHERE ensembl_gene_id_1 != ensembl_gene_id_2
      AND ensembl_gene_id_1 IN (SELECT Ensembl FROM proteinatlas)
      AND ensembl_gene_id_2 IN (SELECT Ensembl FROM proteinatlas)
),
seeds AS (
    SELECT 'ENSG00000146648' AS id, 'EGFR' AS name
    UNION ALL SELECT 'ENSG00000141736', 'ERBB2'
    UNION ALL SELECT 'ENSG00000105976', 'MET'
),
layer1 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b AS id
    FROM sym_edges
    WHERE a IN (SELECT id FROM seeds)
      AND b NOT IN (SELECT id FROM seeds)
),
layer2 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.b AS id
    FROM sym_edges e
    JOIN layer1 l1 ON e.a = l1.id
    WHERE e.b NOT IN (SELECT id FROM seeds)
      AND e.b NOT IN (SELECT id FROM layer1)
),
paths AS (
    -- For each v in layer2, find w in layer1 connected to seed s
    SELECT 
        l2.id AS l2_id,
        s.name AS seed_name,
        count(DISTINCT w.id) AS intermediary_count
    FROM layer2 l2
    JOIN sym_edges e2 ON l2.id = e2.b
    JOIN layer1 w ON e2.a = w.id
    JOIN sym_edges e1 ON w.id = e1.b
    JOIN seeds s ON e1.a = s.id
    GROUP BY l2.id, s.name
)

    l2.id,
    p.Gene,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'EGFR' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) AS egfr_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'ERBB2' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) AS erbb2_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'MET' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) AS met_count,
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'EGFR' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) +
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'ERBB2' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) +
    COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'MET' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) AS total_count,

     CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'ERBB2' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
     CASE WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN seed_name = 'MET' THEN intermediary_count END), 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS seeds_reached
FROM layer2 l2
LEFT JOIN paths ON l2.id = paths.l2_id
JOIN proteinatlas p ON l2.id = p.Ensembl
GROUP BY l2.id, p.Gene
ORDER BY total_count DESC, l2.id ASC
